//: SEC-003: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Never put your user's personal context in a repository, or a private repository's name or contents anywhere public; check the diff first.
why: No harness knows what is private, and a malicious issue once led an agent to copy private data into a public pull request.
to_add: tokens that cannot read private repositories in sessions on public ones
a scan for private repository names at pre-commit, in CI, and in a hook on gh and GitHub MCP writes
